title: IPU trace header
description: A trace is JSON Lines: this header on the first line, then one commit record (commit_record schema) per line (E04-29).

format.description: The element format the program ran in.

program_digest.description: SHA-256 of the program as it is loaded: each IMEM word up to the program length, packed little-endian in its emulator word width (ipu_isa.codec.word.word_bytes()), an empty word as zeros.
